module: Career vehicle inventory: the vehicles table (inventoryId -> info: model, config, niceName, owned, partConditions, timeToAccess, loanType, owningOrganization...), the mapping inventoryId <-> vehicle object id in the world, the current, last and favorite vehicle. It handles adding and removing vehicles, their spawning/entering (spawnVehicle, enterVehicle), saving (one JSON file and one thumbnail per vehicle in career/vehicles/ plus career/inventory.json), the garage computer's "My vehicles" menu, selling, license plates, permissions and big map POIs.
usage:
local invId = career_modules_inventory.getCurrentVehicle()
local info = career_modules_inventory.getVehicle(invId)
print(info.niceName, info.owned)
notes: The inventory has 20 slots (slotAmount); only owned vehicles without takesNoInventorySpace take up a slot.
inventoryId = smallest free integer starting from 1. An added vehicle gets the fields configBaseValue, finalBuyingPrice, defaultThumbnail and plate (config.licenseName).
The first vehicle added becomes the favorite. Owning 3 vehicles unlocks the GARAGE_STARTER achievement.

On adding, the part conditions are initialized on the vehicle side then read; the onVehicleAdded(inventoryId) hook is emitted when they are up to date (note: onVehicleAdded is therefore not immediate).

Emitted hooks: onInventoryPreRemoveVehicleObject(inventoryId, vehId), onVehicleRemoved(inventoryId), onEnterVehicleFinished(inventoryId), onBeforeVehicleSell({inventoryId, price}), onVehicleSaveFinished(savePath).
Loading (onExtensionLoaded) ignores saves of version < 42; if the version is < 64, all vehicles are sold (or loaners returned, or deleted) on career activation.
timeToAccess (s) delays access to a vehicle (purchase, repair); it decreases in real time in onUpdate, including while the game is closed (reduced by the time elapsed since the save).

A non-owned vehicle (owned = false) is forbidden from sale, repair, painting, tuning, parts purchase, plate, storage, favorite, towing to garage; returnLoanedVehicle is allowed only for these vehicles (hidden for owned ones).
getInventoryIdsInClosestGarage(true) returns next(...) of the set of garage vehicles, so any vehicle and not necessarily the nearest (the distance sort is only applied to the full list).
setLicensePlateText tests `if inventoryId` instead of `if vehId`: if the vehicle is not in the world (vehId nil), core_vehicles.setPlateText is called with nil.
saveAnyVehiclePosDEBUG is true: the positions of all vehicles are always restored as saved.

dependencies.desc: Extensions loaded before: career_career, career_modules_log, gameplay_tutorial_setup.

getVehicles.desc: Returns the complete inventory vehicles table (by reference).

getVehicle.desc: Returns the info of an inventory vehicle.

isEmpty.desc: Indicates whether the inventory contains no vehicle.

getCurrentVehicle.desc: Inventory id of the vehicle the player is driving (nil on foot). Listed in the "Debug" functions of the file.

getCurrentVehicleId.desc: Object id (world) of the current inventory vehicle.

getLastVehicle.desc: Inventory id of the last vehicle the player entered.

getVehicleIdFromInventoryId.desc: Converts an inventory id to a world object id (nil if not spawned).

getInventoryIdFromVehicleId.desc: Converts a world object id to an inventory id (nil if the vehicle is not in the inventory).

getMapInventoryIdToVehId.desc: Returns the table inventoryId -> object id for the vehicles present in the world (by reference).

isSeatedInsideOwnedVehicle.desc: Indicates whether the player is in an inventory vehicle (currentVehicle set), owned or not.

returns.desc: true if seated in an inventory vehicle.

getNumberOfFreeSlots.desc: Number of free slots (20 minus the owned vehicles that take up space).

hasFreeSlot.desc: Indicates whether at least one slot is free.

getClosestGarage.desc: Returns the garage whose first zone is nearest to pos (player position by default) in the current level.

getInventoryIdsInClosestGarage.desc: Lists the inventory vehicles present in the nearest garage (intersected zone), sorted by distance to the player. With onlyFirst, returns a single id (the first found by next, see notes).

returns.desc: List of ids, or one id if onlyFirst.

addVehicle.desc: Adds a world vehicle to the inventory: records model, config, name, plate, base value (configBaseValue), initializes the part conditions, assigns a free inventoryId if absent, sets the favorite if it is the first and unlocks GARAGE_STARTER at 3 owned vehicles.

inventoryId.desc: Imposed inventory id, otherwise the first free one.

options.desc: owned is true by default; finalPrice is used for the FLIP_PROFIT achievement.

returns.desc: inventoryId, nil if the object or its data cannot be found.

removeVehicle.desc: Removes the vehicle from the inventory and the world, emits onVehicleRemoved and reassigns the favorite if needed.

removeVehicleObject.desc: Removes only the vehicle object from the world (the vehicle stays in the inventory, in storage); puts the player in walking mode if they were driving it. Emits onInventoryPreRemoveVehicleObject.

skipPartConditions.desc: Not used in the body (remains a TODO).

spawnVehicle.desc: Spawns an inventory vehicle from its config (flattened parts list), restores its part conditions and reconciles the parts inventory. Returns nil if the model or the config file no longer exists.

replaceOption.desc: 1: replaces the player's current vehicle; 2: replaces the object with the same inventoryId; other: new vehicle without entering it.

callback.desc: Called when the part conditions are synchronized.

enterVehicle.desc: Makes the player enter an inventory vehicle (nil = go on foot). No effect if the vehicle is inaccessible (timeToAccess). First updates the part conditions of the spawned vehicles, except loadOption 1.

loadOption.desc: 1: do not reload the vehicle; 2: force reload; nil: enter the existing object or spawn it.

updatePartConditions.desc: Asks the vehicle for its part conditions (getPartConditions) and stores them in the inventory then in the parts inventory.

vehId.desc: Object id; otherwise deduced from inventoryId.

callback.desc: Called once the value is received.

updatePartConditionsOfSpawnedVehicles.desc: Marks all spawned vehicles as modified and updates their part conditions; callback is called when all are processed (or immediately if there are none).

getPartConditionsCallback.desc: Records the part conditions received from the vehicle (ignored with a warning if it is not a table), finalizes a pending add (onVehicleAdded hook) and synchronizes the parts inventory.

partConditions.desc: Conditions, or false if not initialized.

applyPartConditions.desc: Reapplies the saved part conditions to the in-game vehicle (initPartConditions).

vehId.desc: Object id; otherwise deduced from the inventory.

setVehicleDirty.desc: Marks a vehicle as modified: it will be rewritten (with a new dirtyDate) at the next save.

getDirtiedVehicles.desc: Returns the set of inventoryIds modified since the last save.

sellVehicle.desc: Sells a vehicle: emits onBeforeVehicleSell, credits the price (or the value computed by valueCalculator), removes the vehicle, plays the purchase sound, unlocks FLIP_PROFIT if resold above the final purchase price, and logs.

returns.desc: true if sold, nil if the vehicle does not exist.

sellVehicleFromInventory.desc: Sells from the inventory screen: sells, saves the career and sends the data back to the UI.

returnLoanedVehicleFromInventory.desc: Returns a loaned vehicle (career_modules_loanerVehicles.returnVehicle) then saves and refreshes the UI.

expediteRepairFromInventory.desc: Speeds up a paid insurance repair (insurance.expediteRepair), saves and refreshes the UI.

delayVehicleAccess.desc: Makes a vehicle inaccessible for `delay` seconds (timeToAccess) with a reason (bought, repair). Ignored if delay <= 0.

reason.desc: Reason ("bought" or "repair" produce a message at the end).

setFavoriteVehicle.desc: Sets the favorite vehicle (ignored if the id is unknown).

getFavoriteVehicle.desc: Returns the inventory id of the favorite vehicle.

getVehicleThumbnail.desc: Path of the vehicle thumbnail: save file if a capture exists, otherwise the default preview of its configuration.

getVehicleNiceNameTranslated.desc: Translated display name of the vehicle.

getVehicleUiData.desc: Prepares a vehicle's data for the UI: value (and repaired value), express repair price, distance, presence in garage/storage, need for repair, favorite, insurance, permissions (repair, sale, favorite, storage, plate, loan return), listing for sale and performance data.

inventoryIdsInGarage.desc: Vehicles of the nearest garage (computed if nil).

sendDataToUi.desc: Sends to the UI (guihooks vehicleInventoryData) all the vehicles, the choice buttons, the header, the number of free slots and the player's money.

openMenu.desc: Opens the inventory screen (career.computer.vehicleInventory) with configurable choice buttons and updates the part conditions of the spawned vehicles.

_buttonsActive.desc: repairEnabled, sellEnabled, favoriteEnabled, storingEnabled, returnLoanerEnabled (true by default).

openMenuFromComputer.desc: Opens the inventory from the garage computer with three buttons: retrieve at the garage, replace the current vehicle, open the performance index.

openInventoryMenuForChoosingListing.desc: Opens the inventory to choose a vehicle to put up for sale (addListing action on the UI side), all other actions disabled.

chooseVehicleFromMenu.desc: Runs the callback of the choice button with index buttonIndex for the given vehicle.

requestPickerExit.desc: Leaves the selector: navigates to the return route (career.computer by default).

setLicensePlateText.desc: Changes the vehicle's plate text in the world and in its config.

purchaseLicensePlateText.desc: Buys a plate change: pays, applies the text, unlocks NOW_ITS_MINE, plays the sound and marks the vehicle as modified. Does nothing if the player cannot pay.

isLicensePlateValid.desc: Validates a plate text via core_vehicles.isLicensePlateValid.

isVehicleNameValid.desc: Validates a vehicle name: non-empty and without quote, backslash or control character (\b \f \n \r \t).

renameVehicle.desc: Renames the vehicle (niceName) if valid and marks it as modified.

returns.desc: false if the name is invalid.

teleportedFromBigmap.desc: Called after a teleport from the big map: saves the career if the player is in an inventory vehicle and if autosave is active.

debugRespawnCurrentVehicle.desc: Debug: updates the current vehicle's part conditions then respawns it (replaceOption 2).

onExtensionLoaded.desc: Hook: if career is active, loads the files of career/vehicles/ and inventory.json (current vehicle, last, favorite, positions, on-foot position); decrements timeToAccess by the time elapsed since the save.

onCareerActive.desc: Hook: sells the vehicles if the save is too old, then prepares the inventory (vehicles respawning, entering the current vehicle, starting equipment for a new career).

onSaveCurrentProfileAsyncStart.desc: Hook: registers the inventory as an asynchronous save extension (career_saveSystem.registerAsyncSaveExtension).

onSaveCurrentProfile.desc: Save hook: writes inventory.json, updates the part conditions, then writes each vehicle (JSON + thumbnail if requested) and deletes the files of vehicles that no longer exist; at the end, emits onVehicleSaveFinished.

vehiclesThumbnailUpdate.desc: Ids of the vehicles whose thumbnail must be redone.

onUpdate.desc: Frame hook: initial save of a new career (after 10 frames), toasts for a vehicle put into storage or a loan returned, timeToAccess countdown with delivery/repair messages.

onBeforeWalkingModeToggled.desc: Hook: leaving the vehicle (walking mode) enters "no vehicle"; getting into an inventory vehicle records it as current.

enabled.desc: true if switching to walking mode.

vehicleInFrontVehId.desc: Id of the vehicle in front of the player.

onBigMapActivated.desc: Hook: when the big map opens, creates a 'beforeReset' part conditions snapshot for the current vehicle.

onScreenFadeState.desc: Hook: when the screen fade is complete (state 1), removes the marked vehicles then runs the deferred action (vehicle spawn).

onExitVehicleInventory.desc: Hook: the inventory screen is closed.

onEnterVehicleFinished.desc: Hook: stores the vehicle entered as the last vehicle.

onAvailableMissionsSentToUi.desc: Hook: updates the current vehicle's part conditions and sends to the UI whether it needs repair (gameContextPlayerVehicleDamageInfo).

onComputerAddFunctions.desc: Computer hook: adds the "My vehicles" function (order 1), disabled until the starter vehicle is bought.

onCheckPermission.desc: Permissions hook: for non-owned vehicles, forbids sale, repair, mission, painting, parts purchase, plate, tuning, storage, parts swap, towing to garage and favorite; also forbids repairing/selling an inaccessible vehicle, favoriting the favorite or a missing file, storing a vehicle absent from the world.

onGetRawPoiListForLevel.desc: POI list hook: adds a big map marker for each inventory vehicle present in the world (other than the player's), with description (distance, plate, odometer) and thumbnail.
